outcome: access to maternal and child healthcare services
first antenatal visit in first trimester
cohort: Pregnant women and children seeking healthcare services in Natikiri, Nampula, Mozambique, compared to a comparable city health center and the main city referral hospital.
finding: Government restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic led to decreases in most maternal and child health service utilization indicators, including family planning visits, elective C-sections, first trimester antenatal visits, and child vaccinations, while home deliveries increased and hospital deliveries decreased.
